en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.
New-product research: Used target-user preferences and social feedback to distil ZUS Coffee product messages for content and channel communication.
English promotional support: Assisted with 50 Instagram posts through planning, shooting, editing and English copywriting.

Channel coordination and review: Supported online launches and FamilyMart communication by organizing promotional assets, store information and schedules. Tracked performance weekly and completed 15+ reviews to improve subsequent content, contributing to 11k+ account follower growth.

Customer needs: Researched teaching, lesson preparation and self-study needs among university users in mainland China and overseas. Maintained communities and classified 100+ feedback items to support customer communication and product improvements.
Usage support and FAQs: Built the product WeChat content program from scratch and delivered 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and use cases. Core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Partnership follow-up: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation by clarifying needs and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing and project handoff.

University events and cross-team coordination: Arranged demonstration and trial activities with universities, prepared demos, FAQs, teaching cases and course materials with product and business teams, and handled on-site organization and questions. Consolidated user behaviour and feedback into over 10 improvement suggestions for product updates and pilots.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

User insights and promotion planning: Collected user feedback and conducted pricing surveys to understand product needs, willingness to pay and price acceptance. Identified user concerns and usage barriers, and planned communications by usage stage to inform product introductions, acquisition activities and follow-up.
AI dashboard and performance review: Used AI to help build a lightweight operations dashboard tracking key metrics, channel performance and user drop-off points.
Content and creator coordination: Delivered 100+ product-related content items. Screened creators by audience and engagement, and followed up on promotional content and publication.

Campaign execution and channel testing: Independently designed selected online acquisition activities and supported promotional preparation, product promotion and on-site execution at technology events. Coordinated Xiaohongshu, WeChat and community distribution, tested titles, covers and content, and adjusted channel spending based on campaign performance. Registrations rose 50% versus the previous week; first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Master of Marketing candidate graduating in 2027, with working English and experience in customer communication, data analysis and market execution.
Business support: customer requirements, partnership follow-up, product FAQs, events, promotional materials and cross-team coordination.
AI: assisted operations dashboards and data analysis; recurring work organized into SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Data: Excel, SPSS and SQL (basic), for data organization, metric tracking and performance reviews.
Market execution: Xiaohongshu, Instagram and WeChat content; Canva, CapCut and Figma (basic).
